generationPolicy: Exactly one built-in call per sheet; no retries or variants.

prompts.name: mountain
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original cinematic side-scrolling game environment kit atlas, a single PNG raster sheet.
Canvas: square 2048x2048 requested. EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS: eight equal 1024x512 horizontal cells, ordered left-to-right then top-to-bottom. If actual resolution differs, keep exactly this proportional 2-column x 4-row layout. The invisible cell boundaries must be perfectly regular, with no visible grid, labels, frames, borders, text or watermark.
Transparency: cells 0 and 1 in the top row are completely opaque rectangular background landscape panels. All other six cells have a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT alpha background, including every interior opening and the space surrounding each object. Do not paint a checkerboard or a solid backdrop. Keep all objects separate with at least 40px inner padding from their own cell boundaries; never touch or overlap another cell. Background scene content also has comfortable interior breathing room.
Style: cinematic painted semi-realistic dark fantasy with smooth painterly realism, detailed convincing materials, warm/cool atmospheric depth. Fit a side-scrolling game whose eventual people will be realistically proportioned full-size human cutouts; this sheet contains NO characters or creatures. Original artwork and shapes only; do not copy Hollow Knight or any existing game. No pixel art, no vector outlines, no cute cartoon forms, no isometric perspective. Side-on playable surfaces are perfectly flat and horizontally readable, with substantial textured undersides. Objects must remain visible and not crushed into darkness.
Composition: top row backgrounds have detail primarily at the upper edges and sides, with quiet open middles for gameplay; NO foreground playable floors, platforms, doors, characters or UI in the backgrounds. The lower six objects are isolated sprites viewed straight side-on, not scenery vignettes. Tall items fit completely within their own wide cell, not spilling vertically. Structural frames have large empty transparent openings suitable for player movement.
Biome: foggy Qinling mountain ruins, slate midnight-blue cliffs, layered pine mist, weathered timber and stone, restrained copper amber lamps, cool damp air. No moon.
Cell 0, row 1 left: opaque wide landscape panel of distant foggy Qinling peaks and layered pine silhouettes, deep atmospheric valley, no moon, quiet central mist.
Cell 1, row 1 right: opaque wide background mood panel of the interior void of a timber-and-stone belfry, imposing upper rafters, damp stone edges, faint copper amber light, visible depth above and below, quiet dark open middle; no foreground floor.
Cell 2, row 2 left: ONE long flat-topped walkable stone ground ledge with a substantial craggy textured underside, moss and a few hanging roots; very legible straight top edge; isolated on transparency.
Cell 3, row 2 right: ONE tall structural timber-and-stone support pier, iron bindings, weathered masonry foot and cap, fully in-cell; isolated on transparency.
Cell 4, row 3 left: ONE tall walk-through ruined stone-and-timber arch frame, large EMPTY TRANSPARENT center, a complete open structural silhouette, no door, full object within cell.
Cell 5, row 3 right: ONE functional mountain winch lift frame with timber uprights, copper and iron winch drum, pulley and rope, with substantial empty transparent space for movement, complete structure in-cell.
Cell 6, row 4 left: ONE memorable stationary ruined bell shrine, weathered small roof on stone supports and a patinated copper bell, full object visible; isolated on transparency.
Cell 7, row 4 right: ONE small set-dressing cluster of gnarled roots, ferns and an old stone lantern with a restrained amber light; isolated on transparency.
Output only the one eight-cell sheet.
